New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-link-pix-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-pix-on-link-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-pix-on-link.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/pix`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/pix documents Pix on Link for eligible onboarded US businesses and on-session BRL payments, from 0.50 to 3,000 USD equivalent presented in BRL, via Payment Links, hosted Checkout and Payment Element. Australia, Canada, EEA, Singapore and UK businesses can request private-preview access (new raw lines 13-33 and new raw lines 85-99). In addition to broader restrictions, this capture excludes crypto, insurance, telehealth or medicine vendors, and nonprofits or charities. Direct Pix may coexist and uses standard Pix; Link uses the Link payment method and saved details. New Link buyers enter name, address and tax ID and sign up; returning buyers use autofill. Both scan a QR and approve in their banking app before success confirmation in checkout (new raw lines 35-57 and old raw lines 25-41). The customer's bank statement lists Stripe’s service provider Ebanx as the payment recipient and the merchant's name in `Message to payor` (old raw lines 43-45 and new raw lines 59-61). Ebanx separately sends customer receipts on the merchant's behalf (new raw lines 71-73). Stripe calculates customer-paid IOF via its partner and supplies disclosures. November documents limited bank-filed disputes, no merchant challenge, a debit if the partner accepts and Stripe receives notice, and a 90-day refund window with typical appearance in a few minutes in what this guide calls 'your account' (new raw lines 59-83). That wording supplies neither a bank-credit guarantee nor an exact refund deadline measured from submission. source-stripe-pix-on-link.md reflects May's 5 BRL minimum and generic dispute description (old raw lines 12-23 and old raw lines 43-61), so those claims need dated scope. The guide supplies no Link Pix settlement currency or bank payout timing.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/pix, the new USD-equivalent minimum, explicit prohibited categories, coexistence with direct Pix, non-contestable disputes with conditional Stripe balance debit, 90-day refunds and private-preview request are substantive additions or revisions (old raw lines 12-23 and old raw lines 59-61, new raw lines 15-39 and new raw lines 75-99). Reorganization of new and returning customer walkthroughs includes November QR/on-page success wording. Preserve May one-time/on-session, eligibility-qualified Link auto-enablement, copy-code and redirect examples as dated, without assuming omission establishes removal or new integration support (old raw lines 12-41 and new raw lines 41-57). Update source-stripe-pix-on-link.md and its Link concept/index route for May 5 BRL versus November 0.50 USD equivalent presented in BRL. The general Link Payment Element caveat for Brazil and Thailand is a seller/account-location caveat. May places it under Business locations (raw/stripe-link-2025.md:56-70), and November retains it under Country availability (raw/stripe-payments-link-2026-11-07.md:15-17). Qualify the reciprocal Link concept line 42 against eligible US businesses using Payment Element for on-session BRL Pix transactions with Brazilian buyers (new raw lines 8-22 and 63-67). Seller location, buyer location, BRL presentment and private-preview requests are different conditions. BRL or a Brazilian buyer alone does not disqualify eligible US sellers, and these captures do not establish Payment Element access for Brazil-based Stripe accounts. Do not import direct Pix’s separate 0.50 BRL limit, IOF absorption option, merchant settlement table or Pix Automático mandates into Link. The November guide quotes 3.5% customer-paid IOF subject to change, with Ebanx receipt and statement roles distinct from merchant settlement (old raw lines 43-57 and new raw lines 59-73). QR display, bank approval, checkout confirmation, refund submission, bank credit and payout mark different steps.
